I.   COURSE CODE   :   CpE 304 
II.   COURSE TITLE   :   Fundamentals of Mixed Signals and Sensors 
III.   COURSE DESCRIPTION   : 
This course covers operational amplifiers, signal converters, power switching devices and the construction and operation
of sensors and transducers for converting physical parameters into electrical signals and vice-versa. The course focuses
on the application of these devices in developing signal conversion circuits that allows measurement, processing and control
of physical parameters by digital processing systems such as a finite state machine or a digital computer. Topics on
actuators are also included. 
Anchored in the Marian and Augustinian values of truth (veritas), unity (unitas), and charity (caritas), the course encourages
students to design technology that promotes social responsibility, collaboration, and compassion. Through hands-on
projects, learners will not only develop technical proficiency but also embody ethical stewardship — using their knowledge to
create solutions that serve the needs of others and contribute to the common good. 
IV.   PRE-REQUISITE   :   FUNEC, FUNELC 
V.   CREDIT UNITS   :   3 units lecture

fields.title: Fundamentals of Mixed Signals and Sensors
fields.description:
This course covers operational amplifiers, signal converters, power switching devices and the construction and operation
of sensors and transducers for converting physical parameters into electrical signals and vice-versa. The course focuses
on the application of these devices in developing signal conversion circuits that allows measurement, processing and control
of physical parameters by digital processing systems such as a finite state machine or a digital computer. Topics on
actuators are also included.
Anchored in the Marian and Augustinian values of truth (veritas), unity (unitas), and charity (caritas), the course encourages
students to design technology that promotes social responsibility, collaboration, and compassion. Through hands-on
projects, learners will not only develop technical proficiency but also embody ethical stewardship — using their knowledge to
create solutions that serve the needs of others and contribute to the common good.

CLO3: Analyze and apply the behavior of passive components in AC circuits and their instrumentation applications in multidisciplinary teams to design, test, and optimize mixed-signal and sensor applications for engineering solutions [EGA3, PO4, PO9]
CLO4: Exhibit lifelong learning, precision, and ethical responsibility in performing
measurements and calibration tasks. Engage in continuous learning by exploring emerging technologies and trends in sensors, instrumentation, and mixed-signal design for future innovation [EGA 4, PO11, PO13]
